name: Objective and Constraint Algebraic Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit "one is twice the other" constraint with a mathematically equivalent condition requiring a 2x2 state matrix to have a determinant of zero. Replaced the "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with the mathematically equivalent objective of minimizing a base-3 polynomial. This hides both the bipartite nature of the constraints and the independence of the components, forcing models to algebraically deduce that the problem is still bipartite 2-coloring with lexicographical tie-breaking.
